tei:div.tei:p: "$ (439)༄༅// lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel mdor bsdus pa skal bzang thar pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(440)༄༅// na moḥshākya mu na ye/ nges par 'byung bas srid pa'i 'dam las brgal// byang chub sems kyis zhi ba'i mthar mi gnas// chos nyid mngon sum gzigs pa'i rnam 'dren mchog /thugs rje che ldan shākya'i rgyal por 'dud// nges 'byung tshul khrims gser gyi sa gzhi la// byang sems ting 'dzin ri gling bkod pas mdzes// rnam dag lta ba'i shes rab snang byed gsal// jo bo yab sras brgyud par bcas la bsngags// mkhyen gnyis blo gros nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs// mkhas btsun bzang po'i grags pas 'jig rten khyab// bstan la ston pa gnyis pa'i phrin las can// ngo mtshar skyes chen mchog der gus phyag 'tshal// gang des gzhan dring mi 'jog mkhyen spyod kyis// mdo rgyud dgongs pa tshul bzhin thugs chud nas// brtse bas gzhan la 'doms pa'i legs bshad kyi// snying po lam gtso rnam gsum 'di rmad byung*// gang zhig rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi snying por gyur pa/ thar 'dod rnams kyi (441)'jug ngogs bla na ma mchis pa'i bstan bcos 'di 'chad pa la gnyis/ bstan bcos 'chad pa'i yan lag mtshon tsam smos pa dang*/ bstan bcos dngos bshad pa'o// dang po la lngas bstan te/ dang po 'di nyid mdzad pa po su zhe na/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po rnams kyis tshad mar gyur pa'i lung mang pos bstan cing*/ 'phags bal gangs can rnams su bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa'i paṇḍi ta 'ga' zhig dang*/ khyad par bod du mar do lo tsā ba chos kyi dbang phyug /rngog lo blo ldan shes rab/ mtsho sna ba shes rab bzang po sogs su skye ba bzhes pa'i mthar dam pa 'di nyid du 'khrungs nas/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs kyis mkhyen rab thogs pa med pas mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa thugs su chub nas gang la'ang 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa thob/ khyad par 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi bzhed pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba mthar thug pa dang*/

dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyi bka' (442)gdams rin po che'i bslab spyod zung du 'brel pa'i shing rta'i lam srol chen po btsugs te mkhas btsun bzang po'i mthar phyin pa'i slob ma brgya phrag mang pos rgyal ba'i bstan pas chen po'i khongs su khyab par spel/ khyad par 'phags pa'i mdzad chen bzhir grags pa sogs rlabs po che'i rnam thar dang phrin las mtha' yas/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin pas grub pa'i rnam thar thun mongs ma yin pa mnga' bas dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos kyang che ba'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab par bsngags pa mdzad pa dang*/ sku tshe de'i phyi mar dga' ldan tu rgyal ba byams pa'i spyan sngar byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal snying por 'khrungs pa sogs sprul pa du mar ston cing*/ skal bzang gi sangs rgyas bcu gcig pa spyan legs su 'tshang rgya ba sogs lung bstan brnyes pa'i gang zag de nyid kyis so// gnyis pa su zhig gi don tu mdzad ce na/ rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya thar pa don gnyer gyi skal pa bzang po dad pa ldan pa spyi dang*/ bye brag slob ma rnams kyi mchog tshe rabs mang por theg pa chen po la blo sbyangs pa'i las 'phro can tsha kho dbon po ngag dbang grags pas zhus pa'i ched du'o// gsum pa lung gang nas btus zhe na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas gsungs pa'i mdo sngags dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i zab don snying po bsdus pa yin mod kyi/ khyad par nges 'byung 'khor lo dang po dang*/ byang sems dang lta ba gnyis 'khor lo bar mtha' gnyis kyi gnad don snying po bsdus pa'o// bzhi pa phyogs gang du gtogs na/ mdo sngags gang gi sgor zhugs kyang lam 'di gsum gzhi dang snying po dang srog lta bu yin pas med du mi rung ba'i phyir na theg pa che (443)chung gnyis ka'i phyogs su gtogs pa'o// lnga pa dbu zhabs bsdus pa'i don ni/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi brjod bya mtha' dag skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim par 'du ba rgyal tshab byams pa dang 'phags pa thogs med kyis gsung de gsum yang skyes bu chung 'bring gnyis kyi lam nges 'byung du 'du/

chen po'i lam byang chub sems su 'du/ yang dag pa'i lta ba ni theg pa che chung gnyis kar med du mi rung ba'i thun mong ba ste/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa mtha' dag gnad kyi snying po gsum gyis bsdus pa'o// gnyis pa tshad mar gyur pa'i bstan bcos dngos nyid bshad pa la gsum/ klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don no// dang po la gsum/ mchod par brjod pa/ brtsam par dam bca' ba/ mnyan par bskul ba'o// dang po ni/ rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas ston/ de la rje btsun ni/ bha ṭṭā ra zhes pa'i sgra dang sgrol ces 'gyur bas rang nyid la dad pa'i gdul bya rnams 'khor ba spyi bye brag dang dman lam las sgrol ba'am/ yang na swā mi dang bandhe zhes pa rje dang btsun pa la 'jug pa ltar 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i gtsug gi nor bur gyur pas na rje/ sgo gsum nyes spyod mtha' dag las bsdom pas na btsun zhes brjod pa yin cing*/ bla ma'i skad dod gu ru lci ba sogs kyi don la 'jug pas rgyud yon tan gyis gang zhing rang la bka' drin lci ba dang*/ bod skad ltar na lha dang mi rnams kyi bla'am gong na bzhugs pa'i don yin cing*/ yul de lta bu ni rje rang nyid la thun mongs ma yin par rjes su bzung ba'i bla ma rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dang*/ thun mongs ba dbu ma pa/ red mda' pa/ lho brag grub chen/ chos skyabs bzang po la sogs pa rnams la sgo (444)gsum gus pa chen pos btud pa'i phyag mdzad pa'o// de'i dgos pa'ang rang nyid sngon gyi lo pan skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi spyod pa dang mthun zhing phyi rabs kyi gdul bya rnams la yang mig ltos bzang po bzhag pa dang*/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i bar chad zhi nas rtsom pa mthar phyin par 'gyur ba sogs mdor na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bzhed don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/

rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi snying po'i don// rgyal sras dam pa rnams kyis bsngags pa'i lam// skal ldan thar 'dod rnams kyi 'jug ngogs de// ji ltar nus bzhin bdag gis bshad par bya// zhes gsungs te/ rgyal ba thub pa'i dbang po'i theg pa che chung gi gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa kun gyi brjod bya'i snying po'i gnad don mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par bsdus pa/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang shing rta chen po klu sgrub dang thogs med la sogs pa rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' lam dang lam ma yin pa 'byed pa la phra zhing mdzangs pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa'i dam pa rnams kyis lam du mar bsngags shing bstod pa'i lam srol/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'dod pa rnams kyi 'jug ngogs te 'jug pa'i sgo gcig pur gyur pa'i lam gyi gtso bo bsdus na rnam pa gsum ste/ de'ang gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis sogs rgyud kun gyi dgos don 'gro ba rnams gnas skabs mngon mtho dang mthar thug nges legs thob pa'i thabs sha stag yin cing*/ de la thog mtha' bar gsum du dgos pa'i snying po'i don nges 'byung gi bsam pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ yang dag pa'i lta ba bcas (445)rnam pa gsum po de ni/ rang gi blos ji ltar dbog par nus pa bzhin du snod ldan gyi slob ma ngag dbang grags pa khyod la/ blo bzang grags pa bdag gis lan dang rnam par smin pa la mi re bar brtse ba'i sems kyis bshad par bya'o zhes pa'o// gsum pa mnyan par bskul ba ni/ gang dag srid pa'i bde la ma chags shing*// dal 'byor don yod bya phyir brtson pa yis// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam la yid brton pa'i// skal ldan de dag dwang ba'i yid kyis nyon// ces gsungs te/ dus der gdams pa'i snod mchog tu gyur pa'i slob ma ngag dbang grags pas mtshon skal bzang gdul bya gang dag lha mi la sogs pa srid pa 'khor ba'i bde ba thams cad 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal du mthong nas de la ma chags shing ma zhen par dal ba brgyad dang 'byor pa bcu tshang ba'i chos sgrub pa'i lus rten khyad par can lan gcig tsam thob pa de don med stong log tu mi btang bar don yod par bya ba'i phyir du brtson 'grus drag po brtsams pa yis/

phyi rol mu stegs pa dang*/ kla klo la sogs pa phyi nang gang du'ang ma gtogs pa dang*/ nang par rlom yang thabs shes phyogs re bas 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa'i lam ltar snang dge ba blo ma gtong bar/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dgyes pa bskyed pa'i lam nges 'byung byang sems yang dag pa'i lta ba ste bstan pa'i gnad thams cad rdzogs pa'i gdams pa 'di nyid la yid shin tu brten par byed pa'i skal pa dang ldan pa'i gzur gnas blo ldan gyi gdul bya de dag snod kyi skyon gsum spangs shing 'du shes drug bsten la dwang ba chen po'i yid kyis nyon cig ces pa'o// yang na srid bde la ma chags pas nges 'byung dang*/ dal 'byor don yod byed pa byang sems dang rgyal bar dgyes pa'i lam yang dag pa'i lta ba ste (446)de gsum nyon cig par bskul bar bshad kyang rung ngo*// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum/ nges 'byung bshad pa/ byang chub kyi sems bshad pa/ yang dag pa'i lta ba bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum/ nges 'byung 'tshol dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ nges 'byung bskyed pa'i thabs/ nges 'byung skyes pa'i tshad bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rnam dag nges 'byung med par srid mtsho yi// bde 'bras don gnyer zhi ba'i thabs med la// srid la brkam pa yis kyang lus can rnams// kun nas 'ching phyir thog mar nges 'byung btsal// ces gsungs te/ thar 'dod rnams kyis nyams su blang bya'i chos kyi rnam grangs ches mang yang snying nas sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la thog mar nges 'byung rnam par dag pa zhig rgyud la skye bar dgos te/ de'ang ngan song gsum las thar 'dod tsam ma yin par 'khor ba spyi las brgal 'dod rnam par dag pa'i nges 'byung gi bsam pa shugs drag po rang rgyud la skyes pa zhig med par gyur na/ srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po yi nang du yang dag pa'i bde ba med mod zag bcas kyi bde ba'i 'bras bu tsam la mi gtsang dri la dga' ba'i sbrang bu ltar chags shing don du gnyer ba'i phyin ci log gi blo ngan 'di gang gis kyang zhi ba ste ldog pa'i thabs med la/

de ma ldog par srid pa'i bde ba spu gri'i sor chags pa'i sbrang rtsi lta bu la brkam pa ste sred pa'i zhags pa yis kyang rigs drug tu 'khyams pa'i lus can rnams 'khor bar kun nas dam du 'ching bar byed pa'i phyir na/ thar 'dod rnams kyis thog mar kho nar srid pa'i bde 'byor ji snyed pa kun kyang sdug bsngal gyi 'byung gnas su rig nas de las yid nges par 'byung bar 'dod pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa btsal dgos so zhes pa'o// srid pas 'khor bar 'ching ba'i tshul ni/ rnam 'grel las/ (447)mi shes srid pa'i rgyu yin yang*// ma brjod sred pa nyid bshad pas// rgyun ni 'phen par byed phyir dang*// de ma thag phyir las kyang min// de yod na yod med phyir ro// zhes dang*/ sred pa ni// yod na slar yang 'byung phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis/ dang po 'khor ba mtha' dag la yid 'byung ba'i skyo shas zhig med na/ thos bsam sgom gsum sogs ci byas thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyu las mi 'da' bas bskyed rdzogs sogs zab pa'ang re zhig bzhag nas nges 'byung ma skyes bar du 'bad dgos/ nges 'byung la dran shes bsten pa'i dmigs rnam goms par ma byas na/ dge ba thams cad snang shas kyis dbang byas nas 'khor ba 'ba' zhig gi rgyu byed pa yin no// des na sngags la sogs pa'i gdams ngag gang zab zer ba rnams bzhag nas/ thog mar nges 'byung dang*/ byang sems la myong ba thon pa re bya dgos/ zhes rje rin po che la nyid gdams pa'i dgos pa'o// des na 'khor ba mtha' dag la nges par 'byung ba'i blo rnam par dag pa zhig med na/ tshangs spyod tshul bzhin tu bsrung ba dang*/ thos bsam sgom gsum la blo sbyong ba dang*/ gsang sngags gnyan po'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bskur sgrub mchod bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa sogs gang byas kyang thar pa'i sa bon grungs por mi 'gyur te zag bcas kyi bde 'bras tsam la yid brton pa'i phyir/

jo bo'i zhal nas/ sdom pa gsum la gnas shing dag kyang khams gsum 'khor ba las blo yid ma byung na slar 'khor ba'i rgyu byed/ nyin mtshan tu sgo gsum dge ba la 'bad kyang rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ma shes na phyin ci log gi rtog pa 'ba' zhig gis 'phen/ mkhas btsun ston sgom du yod kyang 'jig rten chos brgyad la blo ma (448)log na ci byas tshe 'di'i 'dun mar song nas phyi ma'i lam mi rnyed gsung*/ yang jo bo sku gshegs khar rnal 'byor pa chag khri mchog gis/ jo bo gshegs pa na bdag gis sgom par zhu zhus pas/ bya ba ngan pa yin bor la thong gsung*/ 'o na 'chad par zhu zhus pas kyang de skad gsung*/ 'o na res bshad res sgom mam zhus pas kyang de skad gsung*/ 'o na ci bgyi zhus pas/ tshe 'di blos thong gsung*/ 'brom ston pa sogs brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyis kyang de kho na gsungs shing phyag len la btab pas don gnyis mthar phyin par 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa nges 'byung skyed pa'i thabs la gnyis/ tshe 'di'i snang shas ldog thabs dang*/ phyi ma'i snang shas ldog thabs so// dang po ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' tshe la long med pa// yid la goms pas tshe 'di'i snang shas ldog / ces gsungs te/ 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi mi khoms pa brgyad dang bral nas chos byas pa'i long yod pa'i dal ba brgyad dang*/ mthun rkyen rang dang gzhan gyi 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa'i rten 'di gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba phun sum tshogs pa ma lus pa bsgrub nus pas na don che tshul dang*/ rgyu dang grangs dang dpe rnams kyi sgo nas rnyed par dka' tshul dang*/ lan gcig tsam rnyed pa'i rten de yang tshe la bsnon pa med cing 'brid byed bar ma chad du yod pas 'jig rten 'dir yun ring bsdad long med par nges par myur du 'chi zhing*/ nam 'chi la yang nges pa med pa dang*/ 'chi ba'i tshe chos rnam dag byas pa ma gtogs rnyed bkur snyan grags sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad bsgrub pa'i phyir du dka' spyad drag pos 'bad kyang phan pa med par ma zad tshe 'dir ngal zhing dub la phyi mar sdug bsngal ba'i rgyu byed pa'i tshul rnams yid la yang yang bsams shing goms pas tshe (449)'dir yun ring sdod pa'i grabs byas pa la dgos pa med par shes nas sngar tshe 'di'i bde skyid 'dod pa'i 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi snang ba shas cher yod pa de go sa ldog nas phyi ma don gnyer gyi blo shugs drag skye'o zhes pa'o//

de'ang gzhi dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa la// dal 'byor gyi ngo bo ni mi khom pa brgyad las log pa yin la/ mi khom pa brgyad ni/ bshes spring las/ log par lta ba 'dzin dang dud 'gro dang*// yi dwags nyid dang dmyal bar skyes pa dang*// rgyal ba'i bka' med pa dang mtha' 'khob tu// kla klor skyes dang glen zhing lkugs pa nyid// tshe ring lha nyid gang yang rung bar ni// skye ba zhes bgyi mi khom skyon brgyad po// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ngan song gsum dang lha tshe ring po ste mi ma yin pa'i mi khom pa bzhi dang*/ mi'i mi khom pa ni/ mi yin yang rgyal ba'i bka' med sar skyes pa/ 'khor rnam bzhi mi rgyu ba'i mtha' 'khob tu skyes pa/ yul dbus su skyes kyang dbang po ma tshang ba/ dbang po tshang yang mu stegs sogs log lta can du skyes pa bzhi yin cing*/

'byor pa bcu la/ rang 'byor lnga ni/ mi yin pa/ sa tshigs sam/ chos tshigs gang rung gi sgo nas yul dbus su skyes pa/ dbang po tshang ba/ sde snod gsum dang de'i brjod bya las 'bras la dad cing yid ches pa dang lnga/ gzhan 'byor lnga ni/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa/ des chos ston pa/ chos bstan pa de gnas pa/ chos bstan pa nyams su blangs pas lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du byas pa'i rjes su 'jug pa/ sbyin bdag la sogs pas chos gos sogs dad pas ster ba dang*/ chos 'chad pa pos snying brtse bas chos ston pa rnams te/ de lta bu'i dal ba brgyad dang*/ 'byor pa bcu tshang ba'i rten khyad par can thob pa 'di don shin tu che ste (450)'di la brten nas mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang dang*/ nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus sogs kyang bsgrub nus shing*/ 'khor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal shin tu bzod par dka' zhing yun ring por myong nges pa'i las stobs ldan rnams kyang*/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig bsten cing*/ stobs bzhi'i sgor zhugs nas 'bad pas sbyang na phal cher tshe 'di nyid la sbyong nus pas don shin tu che/ dper na chu bo chen po brgal ba la gru yod tsa na brgal dgos gru med na brgal thabs med/ de bzhin du 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las brgal ba la yang dal 'byor gyi gru yod pa la brgal dgos/ de med na brgal thabs med/ spyod 'jug las/ mi yi gru la brten nas ni// sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol// gru 'di phyis nas rnyed dka' bas// rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces gsungs/ dal 'byor 'di rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed dka' ba'i tshul/ 'jug pa las/ so so skye bo rnams dang gsung skyes dang*// rang byang chub la bdag nyid nges rnams dang*// rgyal sras rnams kyi nges par legs pa dang*// mngon mtho'i rgyu ni tshul khrims las gzhan med// ces pas/

spyir bde 'gro tsam thob pa la yang tshul khrims la sogs pa dge ba sna re dgos shing*/ khyad par dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten khyad par thob pa la/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung*/ sbyin sogs kyis grogs byas/ smon lam dri ma med pas mtshams sbyar ba sogs dgos pa las/ rgyu de lta bu bsgrub pa dkon pas 'bras bu dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten khyad par can thob pa dkon te/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras ni// mi yi lus kyang 'thob mi 'gyur// mi lus thob par ma gyur na// sdig pa 'ba' zhig dge ba med// gang tshe dge spyad skal ldan yang*// dge (451)ba bdag gis ma byas na// ngan song sdug bsngal kun rmongs pa// de tshe bdag gis ci byar yod// dge ba dag kyang ma byas la// sdig pa dag kyang nyer bsags na// bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang ni// bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur// ces pa ltar 'gro ba rnams phal cher mi dge ba la spyod pa'i rgyus 'bras bu ngan 'gro las ma 'das pas dal 'byor lta ci mngon mtho tsam yang rnyed par dka'o// de bzhin du ngo bo'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba ni/ dpe chos las/ 'o skol mi lus thob pa ni nyin mo'i skar ma tsam yin la/ dud 'gro ni nub mo'i skar ma tsam/ yang dud 'gro ni nyin skar tsam/ yi dwags ni nub mo'i skar ma tsam/ yang yi dwags ni nyin skar tsam/ dmyal ba ni nub mo'i skar ma tsam yin/ ces 'byung ba ltar sa 'dom gang gru bzhi tsam gyi rgyar dbyar dus su sa gu tsi bgrang bar dka' na'ang mi bcu las mi shong ba mngon sum gyis grub cing*/ lung bzhi las kyang*/ ngan 'gro dang bde 'gro nas shi 'phos te ngan 'gror 'gro ba ni sa chen po dang*/ de nas bde 'gror 'gro ba ni phyag sen gyi rtse mos bzhes pa'i rdul dang 'dra bar gsungs pas kyang shes nus so// dpe'i sgo nas rnyed dka' ba ni/ shel gyi khang pa'i logs la sran ma gtor na chags pa dang*/

khab rtser nyungs kar chags pa dkon pa las/ dud 'gro lta bu nas dal 'byor thob pa dkon pa yin no// dal 'byor thob kyang tshe la long med par nges par 'chi ste/ bshes spring las/ tshe ni gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi// chu yi chu lbur bas kyang mi rtag na// dbugs dbyung dbugs rngub gnyid kyis log pa las// sad khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che// zhes 'tsho ba'i rkyen nyung zhing 'chi ba'i rkyen mang bas rlung gis btab pa'i chu'i lbu ba bzhin 'jig par shin tu sla ba do nub (452)gnyid log nas nang par sad rgyu yod pa ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gsungs pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ nyin mtshan sdod pa yongs med par// tshe 'di rtag tu god 'gyur zhing*// snon pa gud nas 'ong med na// bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur// ces gsungs pa ltar zhag gcig song gnyis song*/ zan kham gcig kham gnyis zos tsa na/ btung ba hub gcig hub gnyis btung gin 'chi ba la je nyer song nas myur du 'chi bas tshe la long med/ 'chi ba'i tshe chos ma gtogs gzhan gang gis kyang phan pa med pas chos gcig bya/ de yang myur du bya zhing 'chi la nges pa mi 'dug pas/ lus dang longs spyod gnyen grogs gang gi'ang dbang du mi gtong bar da lta rang nas chos gtsang sing nge ba bya ste/ tshoms las/ sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyis// sngon du gang snga gtol med pas// sang gi chis la mi 'bad par// phyi ma'i don la 'bad par bya// zhes gsungs so// de la tshe blos thengs pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo 'chi ba mi rtag pa dran pa kho na yin te/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'chi ba dran pa ma sgom pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ da gzod mthar 'chi ba zhig 'ong snyam pa kun la yod kyang*/ nyi ma re re bzhin de ring mi 'chi/ de ring 'ang mi 'chi snyam du blos mi 'chi ba'i phyogs 'dzin pa 'chi ka tshun chad la 'byung ngo*// de'i gnyen po yid la ma byas na/ de lta bu'i blo des bsgribs nas tshe 'dir sdod pa'i blo skyes nas 'di dang 'di dgos so zhes tshe 'di tsam gyi bde ba bsgrub pa dang*/

sdug bsngal sel thabs 'ba' zhig sems sems nas/ tshe phyi ma dang*/ thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa sogs don chen po la spyod pa'i/ blo mi skye bas chos la 'jug tu mi ster la/ brgya la thos bsam sgom pa sogs la zhugs kyang tshe 'di pa tsam gyi ched du song nas dge ba ci byas pa mthu chung zhing nyes spyod sdig ltung dang (453)'brel bar 'jug pas ngan 'gro'i rgyu dang ma 'dres par kon na/ gal te 'jig rten phyi ma la dmigs nas sgrub tu chug kyang phyi nas sgrub bo snyam pa'i phyi bshol gyi le lo 'gog mi nus shing gnyid rmugs dang phra mo'i gtam dang bza' btung sogs kyi rnam g.yeng gis dus 'da' bas brtson pa chen pos tshul bzhin du sgrub pa mi 'ong*/ tshul bzhin tu sgrub pa mi 'ong ba de tsam du ma zad tshe 'di'i phun tshogs lhur blangs pas nyon mongs pa dang des drangs pa'i nyes spyod rnams je rgyas su song nas chos kyi bdud rtsi las rgyab kyis phyogs te ngan song du 'khrid par byed pas de las ma rung ba ci zhig yod/ bzhi brgya pa las/ gang la 'jig rten gsum mnga' bdag /rang nyid 'chi bdag byed po med// yod des rnal zhing gnyid log na// de las ma rung gzhan ci yod// ces bya ba dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ thams cad bor te cha dgos par// bdag gis de ltar ma shes nas// mdza' dang mi mdza'i don gyi phyir// sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas// zhes so// 'chi ba dran pa sgom pa'i phan yon ni/ 'chi ba dran pa sgom pa'i blo rnal ma zhig skyes na/ dper na de ring sang gnang 'chi bar thag chod pa na chos kyi go ba thag thug yod pa yan chad la gnyen la sogs pa dang 'grogs su med pa mthong nas de la sred pa ldog cing gtong ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas snying po len 'dod phal cher la ngang gis 'byung ba ltar/ rnyed bkur sogs 'jig rten gyi chos kyi 'bad pa thams cad snying po med par mthong nas nyes spyod las ldog cing*/

skyabs 'gro dang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i las bzang po gsog pas go 'phang dam par rang nyid 'dzegs te 'gro ba rnams kyang der khrid pas de las don che ba ci zhig yod/ de'i phyir dpe du mas kyang bsngags te mya ngan 'das chen las/ zhing rmo (454)ba rnams kyi nang nas ston gyi lo mchog go /rjes thams cad kyi nang na ba glang gi rjes mchog go /'du shes thams cad kyi nang na mi rtag pa dang 'chi ba'i 'du shes mchog yin te/ 'di dag gis ni khams gsum gyi 'dod pa dang*/ ma rig pa dang nga rgyal thams cad sel to// zhes dang*/ de bzhin tu nyon mongs pa thams cad cig char 'joms pa'i tho ba/ dge legs thams cad cig car bsgrub pa'i sgor gyur pa la sogs pas bsngags pa'o// mdor na skyes bu'i don bsgrub pa'i dus ni rten khyad par can thob pa'i dus 'di kho na yin la/ 'o skol phal cher ngan 'gror bsdad cing bde 'gror lan re tsam 'ongs kyang mi khoms pa'i gnas su shas che bas der chos bsgrub pa'i skabs ma rnyed la/ bsgrubs pas chog pa'i rten re rnyed pa na'ang chos tshul bzhin du mi sgrub pa ni da dung mi 'chi snyam pa 'di la thug 'dug pas na blos mi 'chi ba'i phyogs 'dzin pa ni rgud pa kun gyi sgo dang*/ 'chi ba dran pa ni phun tshogs thams cad kyi sgo'o// de'i phyir 'di las chos zab mo gzhan bsgom rgyu med pa rnams kyis nyams len no snyam pa dang*/ bsgom bya yin kyang dang por cung zad sgom gyi rgyun du nyams len du mi 'os so snyam du mi bzung bar thog mtha' bar gsum du dgos 'dug la nges par snying thag pa nas bskyed de bsgom par bya'o// gsung*/ gnyis pa phyi ma'i snang shas ldog thabs ni/ las 'bras mi bslu 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rnams// yang yang bsam na phyi ma'i snang shas ldog / ces gsungs ste/ dper na nas 'bras gro sran sogs sa bon tha dad pa btab pa'i myu gu'ang so sor ma 'chol bar skye ba ltar/

las dkar nag gi 'bras bu'ang bde sdug so sor ma 'chol bar rkyen dang 'phrad tshe 'byin pas na mi bslu ba sogs mdor na las nges pa 'phel che ba ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad pa byas pa chud mi za ba'i tshul dang*/ sdug (455)bsngal brgya dang drug dang gsum la sogs pa 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi sdug bsngal rnams glo ba nang du phyogs nas yang nas yang du zhib par bsam pa na sngar phyi ma phan chad du lha mi'i dpal 'byor don du gnyer ba'i snang ba shas cher yod pa de go sa ldog nas thar pa don gnyer gyi blo shugs drag skye'o zhes pa'o// 'di la las 'bras bsam pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa gnyis las/ dang po la las kyi lam bcur gsungs te/ srog gcod/ ma byin len/ log g.yem ste lus kyi las gsum/ rdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal te ngag gi las bzhi/ brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta ste yid kyi las gsum rnams bsdoms pa bcu po nag po'i las bcu ste/ de las ldog pa dkar po'i las lam bcur dge mi dge'i las thams cad bsdus pa yin la/ de'ang las nges pa ni/ sa bon dkar nag so so las 'bras bu dkar nag mi 'chol bar 'byung ba bzhin/ las mi dge ba spyad na 'bras bu sdug bsngal kho na 'byung bar nges la/ las dge ba spyad na 'bras bu bde ba 'byung bar nges te/ 'phags pa des pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ sa bon tsha ba rnams kyis ni// 'bras bu tsha ba skye bar 'gyur// sa bon mngar ba rnams kyis ni// 'bras bu mngar ba skye bar 'gyur// dpe zlar bya ba 'di yis ni// sdig pa'i rnam smin tsha ba dang*// dkar po'i 'bras bu mngar ba yang*// mkhas pa rnams kyis shes par bya// zhes gsungs/ las 'phel che ba ni/ sdig pa'i las che chung gang yin kyang bshags pa sogs gnyen pos ma bcos na zhag re bzhin skyed re 'phel ba dang rjes su yi rang na lhag par 'phel che zhing*/ dge ba'i las rnams kyang ngom pa dang 'gyod pas ma zad na de bzhin tu 'phel zhing bsngo bas rgyas thebs na de las kyang (456)'phel che bas rgyu las kyi dus chung ngu las med kyang 'bras bu rgya cher smin par 'gyur te/

tshom las/ sdig pa chung ngu byas pas kyang*// 'jig rten pha rol 'jigs chen 'gyur// phung khrol chen po byed 'gyur te// khong par song ba'i dug bzhin no// bsod nams chung ngu byas pas kyang*// 'jig rten pha rol bde chen 'dren// don chen dag kyang byed 'gyur te// 'bru rnams phun tshogs smin pa bzhin// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad pa ni/ rang gis byas pa'i las dge sdig che chung gang yin kyang 'bras bu bde sdug mi 'chol bar 'gyur gyi ma byas pa dang 'phrad mi srid de/ mdo las/ lhas byin nyid kyis byas pa'i las rnam par smin pa ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la sogs pa la mi smin gyi de nyid kyis zin pa'i phung po sogs la smin par 'gyur bar gsungs pas mtshon no// las chud mi za ba ni/ mdo las/ lus can dag gi las rnams ni// bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za// tshogs shing dus la babs pa na// 'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur// zhes sems can rnams kyis bsags pa'i dkar nag gi las ni nam yang med par mi 'gyur bar bskal pa sogs dus yun ring bdag gis chod na'ang zhing sa skam po la sa bon yod pa gsher dang 'phrad pa bzhin las gang yin pa de la gsos btab pa de'i tshe bde sdug gi 'bras bu smin par 'gyur ba ste/ mdo 'dul las 'byung ba'i gtam rgyud rnams las rtogs par byas na nges shes 'drongs par 'gyur/ des na dang por nag po'i las 'bras bsam/ de nas dkar po'i las 'bras bsams nas spro ba'i sems kyis dge ba chung ngu la'ang ma brnyas par bsgrub par bya'o// gnyis pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ rgyal tshab byams pas/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med ltar 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med// (457)de yi sdug bsngal rtag tu kha ba rgya tshwa la sogs reg skyes bzhin// ces gsungs pa ltar 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang bzhin las nam yang ma 'das te/

shin tu bzod par dka' ba ngan song gsum ni/ dmyal ba tsha grang*/ yi dwags bskres skom/ dud 'gro glen lkugs bkol spyod kyis nyam thag pa 'bras tsha ba'i steng du phol mig byung ba ltar sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba ni/ bshes spring las/ dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang*// dran dang bklags dang gzugs su bgyis rnams kyang*// 'jigs par bskyed par 'gyur na mi bzad pa'i// rnam smin nyams su myong rnams smos ci 'tshal// ces sogs gsungs pa ltar bzod pa'i glags med la/ bde 'gror skyes nas sprin bar gyi nyi ma lta bu gnas skabs lus sems bde ba cung zad myong rung rtag mi thub pa 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal can yin pa dang*/ zhi ba lhas/ bde 'gror yang dang yang 'ongs te// bde ba mang po spyad spyad nas// shi nas ngan song sdug bsngal ni// yun ring mi bzad rnams su lhung*// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bde 'gror skyes kyang mi la skye rga na 'chi sogs sdug bsngal brgyad dang*/ lha min la 'thab rtsod/ lha la 'chi 'pho ltung byed sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gzir bar ma zad btson rar chud pa'i mi zhig de nas thon kyang slar btson khang gzhan du mi 'jug pa'i nges pa med pa bzhin bde 'gro nas ngan 'gror mi 'gro ba'i gding tshad ma rnyed pa'i phyir na 'khor ba las mthar phyin sdug bsngal gyi zug rngu dang nam yang mi 'bral la/ de'i rtsa ba yang 'dod yon lnga la chags pa kho na'i skyon las byung ba ni/ dper na/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ ri dwags nyid ni sgra tsam gyis// reg pas glang po brlag par 'gyur// gzugs nyid kyis ni phye (458)leb ste// ro yis nya nyid rnam par brlag /bung ba dri la chags pas te// 'di dag rgyu ni re re yin// skyes bu dag ni gcig la yang*// lnga po 'di dag rtag ldan zhing*// nyin mtshan du ni rab tu 'joms// bde gnas ji ltar thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

po to ba'i zhal nas/ 'o skol 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i rjes su snyeg snyeg nas/ 'khor ba 'di thog ma med pa nas gting mtha' med par 'khyams te phung tshabs dang brlag tshabs 'di las che ba med gsungs so//

des na rtag tu 'dod yon la blo ldog cing 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spyi dang*/ khyad par 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa gal che ste/ ji skad du/ 'khor ba'i nyes brgya sems dpa'i tshul// mang yang sdug bsngal sdug bsngal gyis// 'jigs nas thar 'dod phyugs la'ang yod// zag bcas tshor ba bde ba las// yid 'byung phyi rol pa la'ang mchis// des na 'du byed rang bzhin gyi// zag bcas nyer len phung po 'di// sdug bsngal 'grub dang grub pa'i snod// nad dang 'bras dang zug rngu ltar// dmigs nas bsgom na byings g.yo lags// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// gsum pa nges 'byung skyes pa'i tshad bshad pa ni/ de ltar goms pas 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la// yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi skye zhing*// nyin mtshan kun tu thar pa don gnyer blo// byung na de tshe nges 'byung skyes pa lags// zhes gsungs te/ de ltar 'khor ba spyi bye brag gi sdug bsngal rang rgyud la bskor nas yang yang goms par byas pa la brten nas lha mi'i gtso bo rnams kyi bde bas mtshon srid pa 'khor ba'i phun sum tshogs pa gang la'ang skyugs nad can gyis zan mthong ba ltar 'di lta bu thob na snyam pa'i yid la smon pa skad cig tsam yang rgyud la mi skye (459)zhing*/ nyin mtshan gyi dus kun tu zag bcas nyer len gyi phung pos bsdus pa'i yid brton med pa'i 'khor ba las grol ba'i thar pa myang 'das kyi bde ba zhig da lta nyid du thob na snyam du don du gnyer ba'i blo gzhan rkyen gyis ldog mi nus pa'i shugs drag la rgyun ring ba rtsol med du skye ba byung ba na/ dus de'i tshe thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba bcos ma ma yin pa'i nges 'byung gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa rang rgyud la skyes pa lags so// zhes pa'o// rgya ma ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis kyang*/ de ltar bsam pas tshe 'di'i 'dod pa thams cad la zhen pa log /de 'phel bas 'khor ba mtha' dag la zhen pa log pa zhig byung na/

de tsa na thar pa'i lam sna zin pa zhes kyang bya ste/ de med na ci yod kyang thar pa'i lam sna mi zin/ de byung na gzod chos pa'i khyur tshud pa lags so// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa byang chub kyi sems bshad pa la gnyis/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i thabs so// dang po ni/ nges 'byung de yang rnam dag sems bskyed kyis// zin pa med na bla med byang chub kyi// phun tshogs bde ba'i rgyu ru mi 'gyur bas// blo ldan rnams kyis byang chub sems mchog bskyed// ces gsungs te/ gong du bshad pa'i skyes bu chung 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam srid pa'i phun tshogs las yid nges par 'byung ba tsam gyi bsam pa de yang*/ mkha' mnyam gyi sems can rnams kyi ched du rnam par dag pa'i sems bskyed kyi rtsis zin pa med na bden pa bzhi dang*/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang*/ phar phyin drug la sogs pa yun ring por nyams su blangs pa rnams kyang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don phun (460)sum tshogs pa 'grub pa'i gtan gyi bde ba mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu ru mi 'gyur te/ rang don yid byed dman pa'i lam du gol ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ de bas na rang don gtso bor don du mi gnyer bar gzhan don rgya chen po bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa'i theg chen gyi rigs sad pa'i blo gros kyi rtsal dang ldan pa'i dbang rnon skyes bu mchog gi rigs can rnams kyis/ rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun dang bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas theg chen gyi lam gyi gzhung shing lta bu smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi sems mchog tu bskyed par bya'o// zhes pa'o// de'ang bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob byed kyi rgyu ni byang chub kyi sems rin po che las gzhan ci'ang yod pa ma yin te/

dper na/ nas kyi sa bon ni nas kyi myu gu'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu yin pas/ de yod na nas myug gi thun mong ba'i rgyu chu lud drod gsher rnams kyang nas myug gi rgyur 'gyur gyi/ nas kyi sa bon med na chu lud sogs yod kyang nas myug skyed par mi nus pa bzhin yin te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'dis// bla med byang chub thob 'dod na// de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems// ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang*// phyogs mthas gtugs pa'i snying rje dang*// gnyis la mi brten ye shes lags// zhes pa dang*/ rgyud bla ma las/ theg mchog la mos sa bon shes rab ni// sangs rgyas chos skyed ma dang bsam gtan gyi// bde ba'i mngal gnas snying rje'i ma ma can// gang yin de dag thub pa'i rjes skyes sras// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang pha ni bu yi rang gi rigs nges pa'i rgyu yin pas/ pha bod la bu bod pa kho na skye yi/ rgya hor gyi rigs can mi skye/ ma ni bu de yi thun mong gi rgyu yin pas/ bod pa dang 'grogs na bod/ (461)rgya hor dang 'grogs na rgya hor gyi rigs can skye ba ltar/ byang chub kyi sems ni/ rang rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag theg pa chen po bar 'jog pa'i sa bon lta bu dang*/ yang dag pa'i lta ba ni/ nyan thos kyi byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pa dang 'grogs na rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag nyan thos kyi byang chub tu 'khrid par byed/ rang rgyal gyi byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pa dang 'grogs na/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag rang rgyal gyi byang chub tu 'khrid par byed/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pa dang 'grogs na/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid par byed pa ste byang chub gsum thun mong gi rgyu yin pas/ sher phyin la bstod pa na yum chen mo shes pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems la bstod pa na/

sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o// zhes gsungs/ des na rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas yang nas yang du bsngags shing*/ 'phags pa yab sras dang jo bo a ti sha la sogs pa rnams kyis 'di kho nar gdams pa'i snying por mdzad pa'i lo rgyus dang gsung sgros mtha' yas pa las phyogs tsam mtshon na/ dge bshes smyug rum pa'i zhal nas/ byang chub kyi sems 'di cig skyer btub na tshogs kho rang gis sog /sgrib pa yang kho rang gis sbyong*/ bar chad kyang kho rang gis sel te gsung*/ 'di cig med par/ rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dang*/ lha'i sku dang stong pa nyid la sogs pa bsgoms kyang 'dod par gom pa gang bas phyed kyang mi phyin gsung*/ des na myur du sangs rgya ba la byang chub kyi sems sgom pa las gdams ngag lhag pa med pas/ de la nges pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ nyams len thams cad de'i phyir du dril nas byed pa gal che ste/ lam (462)rim chen mo las/ 'jig rten na rtswa rnga ba dang zor ba rdor ba'i dpe brjod pa ltar rin po che'i sems 'di gnad du ma song bar yun ji tsam dge sbyor la 'bad blo byas kyang zor ba shin tu rtul bas rtswa rnga ba dang 'dra ste/ sa bcad pa ci yang med la sems 'di nyid gnad du zhig song na re zhig la mi rnga bar zor ba brdar nas rnon por byas te de nas brngas pa cung zad tsam la'ang mang du brngas zin pa dang 'dra ste/ skad cig re re la'ang sgrib pa sbyong ba dang tshogs sdud pa bde blag tu nus shing dge ba chung ba dang bar skabs su 'dzad pa rnams kyang che ba dang mi zad par byed pa'i phyir zhes pa dang*/ dge bshes ston pa la/ dge bshes lhab chung ston pas yang dang yang du byang chub kyi sems sbyongs bya ba de/ bla ma'i gdams ngag bsgoms pas rgyud la ma skyes kyang yang dang yang du bsgoms pas skye bya ba lags sam zhus pas/

dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas jo bo ston pa/ de gcig pus kyang mi 'ong*/ gtso bor byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la sbyong ba'i tshul bzhin yid la byed pa de gzhi mar byas/ zhar la tshogs sog /zhar la sgrib pa sbyang*/ zhar la sdig pa'i grogs po spang zhing*/ zhar la dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ zhar la chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom zhing tshul bzhin yid la byed na 'ong ba yin/ ces gsungs/ spyir byang chub kyi sems skyes pa tsam la phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab cing mdor bsdu na spyod 'jug las/ ming don gnas 'gyur ba/ sdig pa'i gnyen po byed pa/ dge ba gong du 'phel ba/ ngan song gi skye sgo gcod pa/ sangs rgyas nges par thob pa dang lngar gsungs so// gnyis pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i thabs ni/ shugs drag chu bo bzhi yis rgyun gyis khyer// bzlog dka' las kyi 'ching ba dam (463)pos bsdams// bdag 'dzin lcags kyi dra ba'i sbubs su chud// ma rig mun pa'i smag chen kun nas 'thibs// mu med srid par skye zhing skye ba ru// sdug bsngal gsum gyis rgyun chad med par mnar// gnas skabs 'di 'drar gyur pa'i ma rnams kyi// ngang tshul bsam nas sems mchog bskyed par mdzod// ces gsungs te/ ri gzar ngos kyi 'bab chu ltar shugs shin tu drag pa'i skye rga na 'chi'am/ 'dod pa srid pa ma rig pa lta ba ste chu bo chen po bzhi yi rgyun gyi cha bsags pas ngal bso med par sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor ni khyer/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gyis kyang bzlog cing grol bar dka' ba'i zag bcas kyi bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa dang mi g.yo ba'i gnas su ni bsdams/ gang zag dang chos kyi bdag tu 'dzin pa bcas par dka' ba lcags kyi drwa ba lta bu'i sbubs su ni chud/ nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba las 'bras dang de kho na nyid sogs bya ba dang bya min gyi gnas tshul mi shes pa'i ma rig pa'i mun pa stug po'i smag rum chen po phyogs kun nas chu'i khur gyis non pa'i dbyar gyi char sprin lta bur ni 'thibs/

thog ma dang tha ma'i mu mtha' 'di zhes ngos bzung du med pa'i srid pa 'khor ba'i gnas ngan 'di lan gcig gnyis tsam ma yin par skye zhing skye ba ru sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal te/ sdug bsngal gsum gyis skad cig kyang rgyun chad pa med par ni mnar ba sogs gnas skabs te ngang tshul chos bzod par dka' ba 'di 'dra bar gyur pa'i 'gro ba 'di thams cad rang gi tshe rabs snga ma'i mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med cing*/ de yang lan mang por byas shing byas res kyis gnod pa las bskyabs (464)nas bde ba dpag med sbyin pa'i drin can sha stag yin pas ma rgan sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal ba'i ngang tshul rang nyams la dpags te legs par bsams pa la brten nas/ drin lan du bde ba dang ldan na snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral na snyams pa'i snying rjes drangs te/ de rnams sdug bsngal las grol ba bdag gis bya'o snyam pa'i lhag bsam gyi khur khyer ba na da lta ni bdag la de lta bu'i nus pa med/ nus pa su la yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyag gcig la yod par shes nas sems can gyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ci nas kyang thob par bya'o snyam du smon pa'i sems dang*/ de ltar smon pa tsam gyis kyang sangs rgyas mi thob pas sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir de'i rgyu phar phyin drug dang bsdu ba bzhi sogs rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la bslab par bya'o snyam pa'i 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems mchog tu bskyed par mdzod cig /ces pa'o// de la thog mar dge ba'i bshes gnyen las sam/ rten dang dmigs pa'i sgo nas/ shing rta gnyis kyi ring lugs ltar byang chub tu sems ma skyes pa bskyed/ skyes pa mi nyams shing gong du 'phel ba'i bslab bya sems can blos mi spong ba sogs smon sems dang*/ sbyin sogs phar phyin drug

/snyan smra sogs bsdu dngos bzhis mtshon pa'i spyod pa rnams ci nus su bsgrub par bya ba yin la/ thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba la 'bad dgos te/ de'i man ngag jo bo rje nas brgyud pa la lugs gnyis/ shar ba'i slob ma gtum ston blo gros grags nas brgyud pa la rgyu 'bras rim pa lnga'i sgo nas bsgom ste/ bdag sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur byang chub kyi sems (465)dgos par 'dug /de'i rgyur snying rje/ de'i rgyur byams pa/ de'i rgyur byas pa shes shing drin bzo ba/ de'i rgyur sems can thams cad pha ma drin can sha stag tu shes dgos/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal dang bral/ bde ba la dgod pa'i phyir bdag nyid sangs rgyas 'thob par byas nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya'o snyam du bsam pa dang*/ bya yul ba'i slob ma gtsang pa rin po che nas brgyud pa la rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyis blo sbyong bar gsungs te/ 'thob bya'i sangs rgyas nyid rgyu byang chub kyi sems las skye/ de lhag bsam rnam par dag pa las/ de snying rje chen po/ de byams pa chen po/ de yid du 'ong ba las/ de byas shes drin bzo/ de rtsa ba'i mas phan btags pa ltar sems can thams cad pha mar shes pa las skyes/ des na sems can re re bzhin byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ sangs rgyas la 'god 'dod kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa kho na bsgom dgos shing*/ de'i man ngag khyad par du 'phags pa/ spyod 'jug las/ gang zhig bdag dang gzhan rnams ni// myur du skyob par 'dod pa des// bdag dang gzhan du brje bya ba// gsang ba'i dam pa spyad par bya// zhes dang*/ bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na// sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing*// 'khor ba na yang bde ba med// ces bdag gzhan mnyam par brje ba'i bde sdug gi gtong len spel mar byed pa ni nyams len gyi gnad 'gag che shos yin pas de'i tshul blo sbyong don bdun ma sogs las shes par bya'o//

gsum pa yang dag pa'i lta ba bshad pa la gnyis/ yang dag pa'i lta ba 'tshol dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ btsal ba'i lta ba dngos bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mi ldan na// nges 'byung byang chub sems la goms byas kyang*// srid pa'i rtsa (466)ba bcad par mi nus pas// de phyir rten 'brel rtogs pa'i thabs la 'bad// ces gsungs te/ chos rnams kyi gnas lugs kyi don phyin ci ma logs par rtogs par byed pa'i zab mo'i shes rab dang mi ldan na/ sngar bshad pa'i nges 'byung dang byang chub kyi sems gnyis la yun ring po ji tsam goms par byas pa dang*/ bsam gtan gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin la bskal pa'i bar du gnas nus shing*/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa dang ldan par gyur kyang*/ srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba mthar thug pa bdag 'dzin lhan skyes kyi zhen yul sun dbyung zhing bcad par ste slar skye mi rung gi chos can du byas te spong bar mi nus pa kho na yin pas/ thar 'dod rnams kyis stong pa nyid kyi don zab mo rten cing 'brel bar 'byung bas 'grub pa'i tshul rtogs pa'i thabs la dka' ba brgya phrag du ma'i sgo nas 'bad par bya'o// zhes pa'o// de'ang nges 'byung dang byang sems sogs kyis srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod mi nus pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba mthar thug pa lhan skyes kyi bdag 'dzin yin la/ de spong ba ni de'i 'dzin stangs kyi zhen yul sun phyungs nas de dang 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba zhig gis spang dgos te/ bzhi brgya pa las/ yul la bdag med mthong ba ni// srid pa'i sa bon 'gag par 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ nges 'byung sogs bdag 'dzin dang 'dzin stangs 'gal ba ma yin pas/ rnam 'grel las/ 'di yul sun phyung med par ni// de spong ba ni nus ma yin// zhes dang*/ byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir// shin tu nyes pa tshar gcod min// ces gsungs so// des na bdag 'dzin spong byed kyi gnyen po bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes pa yin la/

de'ang gang zag gi bdag (467)med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis gang zag gi bdag dang*/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis phung sogs chos la bdag tu 'dzin pa spong bar byed pas na/ gcig du bral la sogs pa'i rigs pa yang dag la brten nas gang zag gi bdag bkag nas bdag med rtogs pa'ang shes rab goms dgos te/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ nyon mongs skyon rnams ma lus 'jig tshogs la// lta las byung ba blo yis mthong gyur cing*// bdag ni 'di yi yul du rtogs byas nas// rnal 'byor pa yis bdag ni 'gog par byed// ces dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ stong nyid lta bas grol 'gyur gyi// sgom pa lhag ma de don yin// zhes gsungs pas so//

de'ang gong du smos pa ltar sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu thun mong ma yin pa byang chub kyi sems yin kyang bu skye ba la pha gcig pus mi 'ong bar pha ma gnyis ka tshogs dgos pa bzhin theg pa gsum ga'i thun mong gi rgyu stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang zung du 'brel dgos te/ dpe 'grel las/ dper na skyes bu mig dang ldan pa zhig gis lam sna drangs na dmus long brgya phrag du mas kyang grong khyer la sogs pa gang 'dod du 'gro nus pa yin/ dpe de bzhin du shes rab stong pa nyid kyi don rtogs nas nyams su blangs na pha rol tu phyin pa lnga yis kyang pha rol tu phyin pa'i ming thob cing thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la 'gro bar nus te/ pha rol phyin pa lnga yi yon tan ji snyed pa// de dag kun kyang shes rab pha rol phyin la brten// zhes pa dang*/ sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba shes rab ste// tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan de bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab kyi bden pa 'dzin pa'i zhen yul sun ma phyung na pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan la rgya cher bslabs kyang bdag med rtogs mi nus/ bdag (468)med rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyis kyi nang nas kyang gang zag gi bdag med gtso bor gsungs te/ lhag mthong chen mo las/ de kho na nyid la ji ltar 'jug pa'i rim pa ni dang por 'khor ba'i nyes skyon bsams nas yid sun te de la 'dod 'dod skyes pa zhig dgos/ de nas de rgyu ma log na mi ldog par mthong nas 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gang yin snyam ste de'i rtsa ba rtsad bcad pas 'jig lta'am ma rig pa 'khor ba'i rtsa bar 'gro lugs la nges pa gting thag pa nas 'drongs nas de spong bar 'dod pa bcos ma ma yin pa skyes pa zhig dgos/ de nas 'jig lta ldog pa de nges bzung ba'i bdag med par rtogs pa'i shes rab skye ba la rag las par mthong nas bdag de dgag dgos par mthong ste/

bdag de yod pa la gnod byed dang med pa'i sgrub byed kyi lung dang rig pa la brten nas nges pa rnyed pa zhig thar pa don du gnyer na med pa'i thabs med do// de ltar bdag dang bdag gi ba la rang bzhin cung zad kyang med par nges pa'i lta brnyed nas de'i don goms par byas pas chos kyi sku 'thob par 'gyur ba yin no// zhes sogs tshig gsal gyi lung dang bcas rgyas par gsungs la/ de ltar bdag rang bzhin med par rtogs na gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi phung po lnga sogs chos thams cad la bden par 'dzin pa'ang shugs la ldog par 'gyur te/ dper na/ shing rta tshig na 'khor lo la sogs pa de'i yan lag thams cad lhag ma ma lus pa tshig pa lta bu ste/ tshig gsal las/ ji ltar shing rta tshig na de'i yan lag dag kyang tshig pas mi dmigs pa de bzhin du rnal 'byor pa bdag gis gang gi tshe bdag med par rdzogs pa de nyid kyi tshe phung po'i dngos po bdag gi ba yang bdag med par rtogs par 'gyur ro// zhes so// de ltar rtogs par byed pa la shes rab zab mo dang (469)ldan pa gal che ste/ dpe 'grel las/ zas la lces reg pa tsam gyis zas kyi ro thams cad mod la tshor nas yong la/ gzar bu de zas kyi gseb tu bcug kyang ro mi tshor/ de bzhin du skyes bu shes rab ldan pas chos thams cad kyi don tshegs med du lon nas yong*/ shes rab med na chos dang rtag tu 'grogs kyang chos kyi don mi longs gsung*/ des na shes rab gal che bas shes rab 'phel ba'i rgyu la 'bad dgos/ shes rab 'phel ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo thos bsam sgom gsum rang yin pas/ drang nges ji bzhin 'byed pa la mkhas pa sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa tshul bzhin du brten nas nges don gyi gsung rab zab mo rnams nyan pa dang*/ bsag sbyang la 'bad pa dang*/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha dbyer med du byas pa la gsol 'debs shugs drag byed pa dang*/

dbu ma'i gzhung rnams la thos bsam sgom gsum phu thag chod par byed pa dang*/ ma 'ongs par shes rab che ba'i rgyu/ khab skud/ snag snyug sogs zang zing dang*/ theg chen gyi chos sbyin gtong ba'ang gal che bar bshad do// gnyis pa btsal ba'i lta ba dngos bstan pa la gsum/ lta ba bstan pa dngos/ lta ba rgyud la skyes pa'i tshan/ lta ba'i chos so// dang po la gnyis/ snang stong dbyer med du rtogs na rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam la zhugs par bstan pa dang*/ snang stong so sor 'dzin na rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ma rtogs par bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ gang zhig 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kyi// rgyu 'bras nam yang slu ba med mthong zhing*// dmigs pa'i gtad so gang yin kun zhig na// de ni sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i lam la zhugs// zhes gsungs te/ rnam grol gyi lam don du gnyer ba'i gdul bya gang zhig kun (470)nas nyon mongs phyogs kyi bden pas bsdus pa'i 'khor ba dang*/ rnam byang phyogs kyi bden pas bsdus pa'i myang 'das kyi chos rnams ma lus pa thams cad kyi rgyu rkyen nyon mongs pa dang las te kun 'byung bden pa la brten nas 'bras bu sdug bsngal bden pa dang*/ bslab pa gsum sogs lam bden la brten nas 'bras bu 'gog bden chos nyid du 'byung ba sogs rnam par gzhag bya 'jog byed dang bskyed bya skyed byed thams cad dus nam gyi tshe yang slu ba med par tshad mas grub par mthong zhing*/ de lta bu'i rgyu 'bras de dag la don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pas legs par dpyad pa na yan lag tshogs pa la shing rtar btags pa tsam las shing rta dmigs su med pa ltar bden grub kyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa'i gtad so'i yul gang yin pa kun rang sar zhig nas don dam par rang bzhin gyis grub pa cung zad tsam yang med par rtogs pa na/ de ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad dgyes pa bla na med pa skyed pa'i lam dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba rtag chad kyi mtha' thams cad dang bral ba de la zhugs pa yin no// zhes pa'o//

de ltar yang rtsa she las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang*// de ni stong pa nyid du bshad// de ni rgyur byas gdags pa ste// de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o// chos thams cad btags don btsal na rdul tsam yang bden par grub pa mi rnyed pa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gnas kyang*/ snang tshul rten 'brel gyi rgyu 'bras bslu med du 'char bas don la bden pa med kyang shar tshul bslu med mngon sum pa la 'gog pa med de bzhin dang me long tshogs pa'i rten 'brel las/ gzugs brnyan byad bzhin du bden par med kyang byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang ba (471)bsnyon du med pa dang mchungs ste/ yab sras mjal ba las/ me long shin tu yongs dag la// ji ltar rang bzhin med pa yi// gzugs brnyan snang ba de bzhin du// ljon pa chos rnams shes par gyis// zhes so// rten 'byung sna tshogs gzugs brnyan ltar snang ba dang de nyid rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong par shes pa gnyis mi 'gal ba ni/ sgyu mas sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan mi bden par shes bzhin tu snang ngo la 'gog med du 'char ba lta bu ste/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ dngos po stong pa gzugs brnyan la sogs pa// tshogs la ltos pa ma grags pa yang min// ji ltar der ni gzugs brnyan sogs stong las// shes pa de yi rnam pa skye 'gyur ltar// de bzhin dngos po thams cad stong na yang*// stong nyid dag las rab tu skye bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de'ang bden pa mngon sum du gzigs pa'i 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams la bde sdug gi rnam pa ci shar yang*/ mi bzod pa dang sred zhen gyi rnam pa gang yang mi 'byung mod/ rang re so so skye bo rnams kyis bden pa mngon sum du ma mthong ba'i ring la/ sdug bsngal phra mo tsam yang mi bzod pa da lta myong bas grub pa 'di ka yin pas sdig pa phra zhing phra ba nas spong zhing*/

dge ba phra zhing phra ba nas sgrub dgos te/ rmi lam don la mi bden par shes kyang 'khrul shes kyi ngor bden par bzung nas dga' sdug nyams su myong ba dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ jo bo rjes/ rmi lam yul gyi bzang ngan rnams// rmi lam blo la bden par snang*// rmi lam bden pas stong na yang*// 'khrul shes can de bden par 'khrul// de bzhin 'di yul ma lus pa'ang*// bden pas stong yang der 'dzin blos// bden pa nyid du mngon par 'khrul// zhes dang*/ 'brom rin po ches/ chos thams cad brdzun pa'i snang ba yang*// gzugs med na gzugs brnyan ga las 'byung*// (472)de rgyu song rdzun yang 'bras 'byung bas// las khyad du mi gsod nyams len pa'i// de lta ba brgyud pa'i bka' gdams yin// ces sogs lung dang rigs pas kyang 'grub pa'i phyir ro// 'di lta bu ni rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dgyes pa'i lam ma nor ba yin te/ rgyal bas chos phung brgyad khri dang bzhi stong bka' stsal pa'i dgos pa 'gro ba rnams gnas skabs mngon mtho dang*/ mthar thug nges legs thob thabs su gsungs pa las gzhan med de/ 'phags pa klus/ dang por mngon par mtho ba'i chos// phyis ni nges par legs 'byung ba// gang phyir mngon par mtho thob pas// rim gyis nges par legs pa 'ong*// zhes gsungs pa'i mngon mtho'i go 'phang ni lha mi'i theg pa la gnas pa yan chad kyis thob cing*/ nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa la lta ba rnam par dag pa dgos te/ de'ang bye brag tu smra ba rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi bdag gis stong pa'i lta ba/ mdo sde ba gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyis grub pas stong pa'i lta ba/ sems tsam pa gzung ba phyi rol don gyis lta ba/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa chos thams cad bden par ma grub cing rang bzhin grub par lta ba'i lta ba sogs mang du yod kyang*/ mthar thug gi thar pa ni/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs/

chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa cung zad kyang med par lta ba 'di kho na las gzhan gyis mi 'thob par gsungs te/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas/ slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni// phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do// de dag kun rdzob de nyid bden las nyams// de las nyams pas thar pa thob yod min// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa snang stong so sor 'dzin na rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ma rtogs par bstan pa ni/ snang ba rten 'brel slu ba med pa dang*// stong pa khas len (473)bral ba'i go ba gnyis// ji srid so sor snang ba de srid du// da dung thub pa'i dgongs pa rtogs pa med// ces gsungs te/ drang don gyi snang ba thams cad rgyu med dang*/ mi mthun pa'i rgyu las mi 'byung bar rang rang gi rgyu rkyen dang*/ 'dogs byed kyi rtog pa la brten nas 'byung ba'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba slu ba gtan nas med pa'i mi 'chol ba'i don la gting tshugs pa'i go ba dang*/ nges don la dpyod pa'i rigs pas btags don btsal ba na rnyed rgyu'i rang bzhin rdul tsam yang med pa'i stong pa nyid la bden grub kyi kun rdzob gang yang khas len rgyu dang bral ba'i don la gting tshugs pa'i go ba gnyis po de ji srid du so sor snang zhing tsha grang ltar 'gal bar mthong ba de srid du da dung thub pa'i mthar thug gi dgongs pa klu sgrub kyis bkral ba ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa'i skabs med do// zhes pa'o// skabs 'dir stong pa khas len dang bral ba'i go ba zhes pa spyir yin min dang yod med sogs kyi khas len med pa la mi zer gyi/ rigs shes kyis btags don btsal ba'i tshe kun rdzob gang yang khas len dang bral ba la byed pa yin te/ rje btsun red mda' pa'i zhal nas/ thal 'gyur ba la khas len gang yang med zer ba'i don gnas lugs la dpyod pa'i tshe lkugs pa bzhin du ci yang mi smra bar sdod pa yang min gyi/

gnas lugs nges pa'i tshe rigs ngo der kun rdzob gang yang khas len rgyu med pa la zer gsungs zhes sogs legs bshad snying po las 'byung*/ gzhan yang*/ kun rdzob rten 'brel gyi snang ba dang*/ don dam rang bzhin gyis stong pa gnyis ngo bo gcig yin te/ myu gu lta bu rang gi don dam ngo bo tha dad yin na/ de rang nyid bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid dang ngo bo tha dad du 'gyur bas/ de bden grub tu 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ byang chub sems (474)'grel las/ kun rdzob stong pa nyid tu bshad// stong nyid kho na kun rdzob yin// med na mi 'byung nges pa'i phyir// byas dang mi rtag dag bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na gzugs phung rang gi gdags gzhi la brten nas ming dang rtog pas phar btags pa tsam ma gtogs gzugs phung dang po nas rang gi sdod lugs kyi ngos nas grub pa stong pas na/ shes rab snying po las/ gzugs stong pa'o// zhes gsungs/ gzugs rung de nyid rang ngos nas gzugs su ma grub pas/ de la gzugs kyi tha snyad shes pa'i phyir du/ ming dang rtog pas de la gzugs zhes pa'i brda' sbyar bas/ tha snyad de'i dbang gis de gzugs su 'thad kyis sgrar mi 'thad pas/ stong pa nyid gzugs so// gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin// stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no// zhes zab mo stong pa nyid bzhi sbyor gyis gsungs so// zhes so// grub mtha' 'og ma rnams kyis mthar thug mi 'thob pa'i rgyu mtshan kyang rin chen phreng ba las/ ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa// de srid de la ngar 'dzin yod// ngar 'dzin yod na yang las te// de las yang ni skye ba yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar phung po rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin lhan skyes de 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin pa la de spong ma nus pas so// skabs 'dir thal rang gnyis kyis don dam dpyod byed kyi rtags kyi dgag bya la phra rags kyi khyad par yang*/

thal 'gyur bas chos thams cad rtog pa'i dbang tsam gyis bzhag par 'dod cing rtog pa'i dbang tsam gyis bzhag pa ma yin par dang po nas rang ngos nas grub pa zhig yod na bden grub tu 'gyur bar 'dod/ rang rgyud pa rnams chos rnams rtog pa'i dbang tsam gyis 'jog mi nus pas/ (475)blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis 'jog cing*/ de yang bum pa 'jog byed kyi blo gnod med des 'jal rgyu'i bum pa ni/ blo de la ltos med kyi tshul gyis dang po rang nas grub grub pa gcig la 'dod cing*/ de ltar grub pa de bum pa rang ngos nas grub pa'i don yin zhes bzhed/ thal 'gyur ba ni/ bum pa de kho rang 'jal byed kyi tshad ma la ltos med kyis dang po nas ma grub par/ bum pa dang bum pa 'jal byed gyi tshad ma gnyis phan tshun ltos nas grub par bzhed de/ tshig gsal las/ tshad ma dag yod na gzhal bya'i don dag tu 'gyur la/ gzhal bya'i don dag yod na tshad ma'i don dag tu 'gyur gyi/ tshad ma dang gzhal bya gnyis ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa yod pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na chos thams cad dang po nas ma grub pa la/ 'dogs byed kyi rtog pa'i dbang gis glo bur du grub pa yin te/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ rgyus med byis pa blo bur yin// don med snang stong dpyad yul min// snang tsam ltos la dri ba zhog /tha snyad dpyad na 'jig pa yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

gzhan yang*/ thal 'gyur ba rnams gang zag gi phung po re re ba gang zag yin nam de tshogs pa gang zag yin nam/ de las don gzhan du gyur pa'i gang zag yod snyam du dpyad pa na/ gang zag rnyed rgyu cung zad kyang med cing*/ de ltar ma rnyed pa de gang zag bden par med pa'i don yin gyi/ gang zag gtan nas med pa'i don ma yin par bzhed/ de ltar btsal bas ma rnyed na ma rnyed pa'i ngang la rtse gcig tu bzhag cing*/ 'dzin stangs shugs chung du song na bla'o zur zhig gis sngar ltar dpyad nas 'dzin stangs kyi shugs gsos pa na dpyad cing dpyad mthar yang cung zad mnyam par 'jog pa yin gyi (476)btags don btsal nas ma rnyed pa na da dung de'i steng du rang bzhin gyis grub pa med snyam pa'i dgag bya'i khyad par bsnan nas bsgom pa ma yin pa sogs rgyas par 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa lta ba rgyud la skyes pa'i tshad ni/ nam zhig res 'jog med par cig car du// rten 'brel mi slur mthong ba tsam nyid nas// nges shes yul gyi 'dzin stangs kun 'jig na// de tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa lags// zhes gsungs te/ sngar bshad pa'i lta ba de nyams su blangs na dus nam zhig gi tshe rgyu la brten nas 'bras bu 'byung ba sogs kun rdzob snang phyogs kyi bya byed thams cad 'thad ldan bslu med du 'char ba'i go ba dang*/ rgyu 'bras sogs 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med par sgyu ma'i rta glang dang rmi lam gyi bya byed bzhin snang yang ngo bos stong pa'i go ba gnyis rang rgyud la gcig gi go ba rnyed tshe gcig shos kyi don phyin ci log tu 'gro ba de/ res mos su 'jog pa med par blo'i yul du snang stong cig car du rten 'brel mi bslu bar gtan tshigs rnam dag gi rig pas mthong ba tsam nyid kyi byed pa la brten nas lta ba la nges shes lhang gis skye zhing*/ des yul rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa'i 'dzin stangs kun lhag ma med par 'jig par byed thub pas na/

dus de'i tshe lta ba la thos bsam gyi dpyad pa rdzogs pa ste lta ba rnam dag rgyud la skyes pa lags so// zhes pa'o// de ltar yang byang chub sems 'brel las/ chos rnams stong pa 'di shes nas// las dang 'bras bu brten pa gang*// ngo mtshar las kyang 'di ngo mtshar// rmad byung bas kyang 'di rmad byung*// zhes dang*/ jo bos/ rnam rtog 'di yis ci yang shes// gzhi med mtshan nyid du ma 'god// da ni sna tshogs snang gyur kyang*// ci yang med kyis cir ma 'dzin// des na bde sdug la sogs (477)pa// rnam rtog ji tsam 'dus gyur kyang*// snang ba tsam zhig kho nar zad// bden pa srid pa tsam kyang ston// snang ba de ni nyid du spyod// ces sogs mang du 'byung ste/ dbu ma'i lta ba la nges pa rnyed pa'i gang zag gi blo yul du snang ba rten 'brel la snyon med du 'char ba dang*/ stong pa don dam gyi 'dug lugs gnyis gcig char du 'char ba mi 'gal ba yang*/ dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis rdo shing rta glang du sprul pa'i tshe/ sgyu ma mkhan rang nyid kyi mig shes la rdo shing rta glang du snang ba dang*/ des rde shing rta glang gis stong par nges pa mi 'gal ba lta bu yin pa gsungs so// 'di'i tshig rkang gsum pa'i don 'chad pa la 'bru gnyer mang yang*/ gtso bo bdag 'dzin gshags 'debs las/ nges shes yul gyi 'dzin stangs kun 'jig ni// rang bzhin grub pa'i 'dzin stangs yin par go /zhes pa ltar nges shes bden 'dzin dang*/ 'dzin stangs de'i 'dzin stangs bshad pa dang*/ spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi lta khrid las/ nged rang la ji ltar snang ba 'di yod na rang gi nges shes kyi 'dzin stangs thams cad dang*/ dmigs pa'i gtad so thams cad 'jig pa ji ltar 'ong*/ des na 'khrul pa 'jig thabs med pa'i lung rigs 'dis gnod cing 'di dang 'gal bas so// so so skye bo'i mig shes sogs kyang snang yul la 'khrul pa dang*/

de'i gzugs sogs thams cad snang ba ltar ma grub pa dang*/ de ltar shes na dmigs gtad 'jig pa dang 'dzin stangs thams cad 'jig pa sogs kyi don yang nged rang so skye thams cad la thun mong du snang bzhin pa bkag nas sgom pa'i don yin/ zhes bshad pa sogs so// gsum pa lta ba'i khyad chos ni/ gzhan yang snang bas yod mtha' sel ba dang*// stong pas med mtha' sel zhing stong pa nyid// rgyu dang (478)'bras bur 'char ba'i tshul shes na// mthar 'dzin lta bas 'phrog par mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs te/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa la rgyu 'bras rten 'brel gyi rnam bzhag 'jog pa mi 'gal ba ma zad/ thal 'gyur ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos gzhan yang yod de dper na/ myu gu chos can/ rang bzhin gyis ma grub ste/ rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags gsal bkod na/ thal 'gyur bas 'dod lan gdab dgos la/ de'i phyir rtags la rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rten pa ni gzhan la brten pa yin cing grogs gzhan la brten nas grub dgos na de'i nus pas myu gu rtsod gzhi de rang ngos sam rang bzhin gyis ma grub par go nus pas na snang ba rten 'brel gyis myu gu rang bzhin yod pa'i rtag mtha' sel ba dang*/ gsal ba la rang bzhin gyis ma grub ste/ zhes dmigs kyis bkar bas na/ myu gu rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa yin gyi spyir ma grub pa ma yin pa go nus pas na rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa nyid kyis myu gu spyir med pa'i chad mtha' sel zhing*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa nyid rgyu dang 'bras bur nam yang bslu ba med par 'char ba'i tshul tshad ma'i stobs kyis legs par shes pa na sgro 'dogs pa rtag pa dang skur pa 'debs pa chad pa'i mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba ngan pas/ sngar bshad pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba rnam par dag pa de'i don 'phrog nus par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// zhes pa'o//

de'ang rang rgyud pa man chad kyis snang bas med mtha' sel zhing stong pas yod mtha' sel ba yin la/ snang ba rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dod de/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa la rgyu rkyen gyis gsar du bcos pa dang*/ ltos sa ltos chos 'jog pa sogs kyi bya byed gang yang bzhag tu med de/ rtsa she las (479)rang bzhin dag ni bcos min dang*// gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin// zhes dang*/ rang bzhin gzhan du 'gyur ba ni// nam yang 'thad pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs so// thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la de las ldog ste snang bas yod mtha' dang*/ stong pas med mtha' sel zhing*/ rang bzhin gyi grub pa la sngar med gsar du bcos su rung ba dang*/ sngar yod blo bur du med par 'gyur ba dang*/ rgyu rkyen sogs gzhan la ltos pa bzhag tu mi rung bas/ rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa'i rgyu de nyid rang ngos nas ma grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ rang gi rgyu la ltos nas 'bras bu dang*/ rang gi 'bras bu la bltos nas rgyur 'gyur tshul dang*/ 'bras bu yang rang gi rgyu dang 'bras bu la bltos nas/ 'bras bu dang rgyu gnyis kar 'char ba'i tshul dang*/ res 'ga' yod cing yang blo bur du med par 'gyur ba'i tshul tshad ma'i stobs kyis legs par shes na/ rtag chad mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba las grol bar 'gyur ro// rten 'brel gyi rigs pa 'dis rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis dus cig car du sel bas/ rigs pa'i rgyal po zhes gsungs pa yin te/ 'jug pa las/ de phyir rten 'byung rig pa 'di yis ni// lta ngan drwa ba mtha' dag gcod par byed// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs kyi gnad 'di ma go bas/ dngos smra ba rnams kyis sa myug gnyis rang bzhin gyis grub ste/ sa bon gyis myu gu skyed pa'i don byed nus pa'i phyir zhes smras la/ thal 'gyur pas gzhal na 'gal khyab yin/ phyi rol pa rnams kyis rten 'brel gyi gnad ma go bar/

dngos po rnams rgyu med dang*/ ngo bo nyid kyi rgyu dang*/ dbang phyug rtag pa sogs las skye bar 'dod dgos pa byung ba yin zhing*/ rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i rten 'brel ni/ rang rgyud pa (480)dang thun mong ba'i rten 'brel dang*/ rtog pas brtags pa tsam las byung ba'am/ grub pa ni thal 'gyur ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rten 'brel gyi don yin zhing*/ de lta bu'i thal 'gyur ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rten 'brel de ni sangs rgyas kyi dgongs bzhed thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos bla na med pa yin te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ de phyir sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni// bstan pa 'chi med yod med las// 'das pa zab mo zhes bya ba// chos kyi khud pa yin shes kyis// zhes gsungs so// gzhan yang myu gu rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sa bon dang chu lud drod gsher sogs kyi rgyu rkyen gyi rten 'brel tshogs na skye yi/ rdo ba dang mgal dum sogs las mi skye ba ni/ stong pa rten 'brel gyi don du shar ba dang*/ myu gu rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las skye ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis rang ngos nas skye ba ma grub pa ni/ rten 'brel stong pa'i don du shar ba'i gnad yin no// gsum pa mjug gi don la gnyis/ nyams su blangs par bskul ba dang*/ rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'o// dang po ni/ de ltar lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi// gnad rnams rang gis ji bzhin rtogs pa'i tshe// dben pa brten te brtson 'grus stobs bskyed nas// gtan gyi 'dun ma myur du sgrubs shig bu// zhes gsungs te/ gong du bshad pa de ltar nges 'byung byang sems yang dag pa'i lta ba ste lam gyi gtso bo rnam pa gsum nyams su len tshul gyi zab mo'i gnad 'gag rnams thos bsam gyis gtan la phab nas rang gis ji lta ba bzhin du 'khrul pa med pa rtogs pa de'i tshe na chos brgyad dang 'du 'dzis dben zhing*/

grong las rgyang grags kyis 'phags pa'i spang ljongs sam nags tshal gyi dgon pa yid dang mthun pa brten par byas te gnas skabs kyi bde ba'i ro la ma sred par drag (481)la yun ring ba'i mi rtag pa'i lcag gis bskul ba'i brtson 'grus kyi stobs ches cher bskyed nas rtse gcig tu nyams su long la rang gzhan gyi don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pa'i skye ba gtan gyi 'dun ma rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du sgrubs shig bu skal ldan ngag dbang grags pa zhes rje rin po ches gdams pa yin no// de'ang nges 'byung dang snying rje nyams su len tshul ni sngar smos pa ltar la/ rje rin po ches/ bka' gdams lta ba'i skyong tshul stong pa nyid 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byas nas skyong bar gsungs pa'i don/ thos bsam gyi dus su dbu ma nas bshad pa'i rigs pa yang dag gis gtan la phab pa'i bdag med kyi don de nyid/ sgom pas nyams su len pa'i tshe na'ang*/ 'khor ba'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i bdag 'dzin de stong nyid kyi don la so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis yang yang dpyad pa'i stobs kyis drangs pa'i lhag mthong gis spang dgos pa'i phyir lta ba bsgom pa'i tshe stong nyid rang rgyud kyi blo'i dmigs yul tsam du byas pas mi chog gi /'dzin stangs kyi yul du byas nas sgom dgos par gsungs te/ po to ba'i be bum las/ kha cig thos bsam dus na rigs pas// rang bzhin med par gtan la phab la// sgom dus mi rtog 'ba' zhig sgom zer// de lta na ni 'brel med stong nyid// logs su bsgoms phyir gnyen por mi 'byung*// de lta bas na sgom dus nyid na'ang*// gcig dang du bral rten 'brel la sogs// gang la goms pas so sor brtag cing*// cung zad mi rtog nyid du rang gnas bya// de ltar bsgoms na nyon mongs gnyen po// lha gcig rjes su 'brang bar 'dod cing*// pha rol phyin lugs spyod par 'dod pas// shes rab sgom pa'i lugs ni de yin// de yang gang zag bdag med goms (482)pas// de nas de ltar rjes su 'jug bya// zhes gsungs/

sgom tshul 'di dag ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lta ba'i skyong tshul yin cing*/ de'i nang nas kyang so skye las dang po pas lta ba thog mar skyong ba'i skabs yin pas/ gtan tshigs sam rgyu mtshan yang dag la brten pa'i rigs shes rjes dpag gis bdag med bsgom pa yin la/ de la bdag med pa'i rgyu mtshan yang yang bsams pa'i dpyad pa ma byas na/ rigs shes des drangs pa'i bdag med nges pa'i nges shes shugs can mi skye zhing*/ de ma skyes na bdag med la dmigs pa'i sgom byung skye ba mi srid/ de ma skyes na bdag med mngon du 'gyur ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ dper na mi rtag pa dang*/ las 'bras dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sogs bsgom pa'i tshe/ bdag ni 'chi'o snyam pa tsam gyi 'dzin stangs gcig kho na bzung bas mi chog par/ bdag nges par 'chi/ myur du 'chi/ nam 'chi la nges pa med pa'i rgyu mtshan zhib tu bsams dgos pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ de ltar yang lhag mthong chen mo las/ lung dang rigs pas sgo du ma nas dpyod pa ni bdag med pa'i don ma rtogs pas rtogs pa'i don du yin la/ lta ba yang rnyed zin pas sgom pa'i tshe mi dgos so snyam na/ de ltar mthong lam du bdag med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa yin pas/ de nas mthong zin pa de sgom pa don med par 'gyur ro// gal te de ni sgom dgos te sgom spang rnams gom pas spong gi /mthong ba tsam gyis mi spong ngo snyam na/ mtshungs (483)te 'dir yang sngar thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pas nges zin kyang gtan la 'bebs pa la goms par byed dgos pa'i phyir te/ ji tsam gtan la 'bebs pa de goms par byas pa de tsam du nges pa shugs drag pa dang rgyun ring ba rnams gsal ba dang brtan par 'gyur ba sogs su mthong ba'i phyir ro// des na rnam 'grel las/ nges pa dang ni sgro 'dogs yid// gnod bya gnod byed ngo bo'i phyir// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

de gnyis gnod bya gnod byed yin pa nges pa ji ltar brtan pa dang shugs drag pa sogs su song ba de tsam du sgro 'dogs la gnod pas 'dir yang rang bzhin med pa'i nges pa je 'phel du btang dgos la/ de yang gnod byed dang sgrub byed du ma'i sgo nas bsam dgos pa'i phyir ro// de lta ma yin na mi rtag pa dang las 'bras dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang byang chub kyi sems dang*/ byams pa dang snying rje sogs la'ang de dag gi go ba rnyed nas mi dpyod par bdag ni 'chi'o snyam pa tsam gyi 'dzin stangs kho na bzung nas brkyang dgos par 'gyur te/ rgyu mtshan kun nas mtshungs pa'i phyir ro// des na nges pa rnam dag 'dren pa la ni bdag ni 'chi'o snyam pa dang*/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa dang*/ sems can snying re rje snyam pa tsam la sogs pa dam bca' tsam res mi chog gi rgyu mtshan sgo du ma nas bsam dgos pa bzhin du/ rang bzhin med pa'i nges pa brtan pa dang shugs drag pa sogs kyang dam bca' tsam zhig bzung bas mi chog gi gnod byed dang sgrub byed sgo du ma nas bsam dgos te/ skyes bu chung ngu'i skabs su yang dang yang du bshad zin to// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// lam gtso gsum po 'di mdo rgyud kun gyi gnad 'dus yin pa'i phyir/ (484)bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes gong ma rnams kyi yang gdams pa'i snying po bla na med par mdzad de/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'brom ston pa la 'phen yul sbras kyis 'brom ming sring gnyis kyis bsnyen bskur zhus nas/ bshes gnyen chen po la jo bo rje lha gcig gi gdams ngag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mnga' ba lags pas/ de ring sangs rgyas thob pa'i gdams ngag gcig mi gsang bar zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ ston pa'i zhal nas/ dang po 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang las rgyu 'bras mang du bsgoms la rang gi khas blangs pa'i bsrung sdom kun dag par bya/ byams pa dang snying rje mang du bsgom la byang chub kyi sems brtan par bya/

de'i phyir tshogs gnyis thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bsag /sdig pa thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sbyang ba la 'bad par bya/ chos thams cad 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i rtsis zin pas dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can thams cad dang thun mong du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya/ de ltar byas na jo bo rje dang ma mjal snyam pa'i mya ngan bya mi dgos/ sangs rgya bar byed pa la chos de las med/ phyis nas 'brom rgan po dang ma 'phrad snyam pa'i mya ngan bya mi dgos gsungs/ ang*/

yang dge bshes ston pa la slob ma sku mched gsum gyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam thams cad kyi don mdor bsdus nas nyams su blang ba'i thabs gcig zhu lags zhus pas/ 'brom ston pa'i zhal nas/ rten gyi gang zag gcig thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la lam gyi 'jug sgo bslab bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig yod kyang rgyud la skye bar bya rgyu'i dngos po gcig las med/ gcig po gang yin na stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can yin/ de la bye brag tu phye na stong pa ni don dam byang chub kyi sems te/ chos thams cad kyi (485)rang bzhin nam gnas lugs ye nas skye med du rtogs pa de yin/ snying rje ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems te de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen po skyes pa de yin/ des na theg pa chen po'i nyams su len pa rnams kyi dang po byang chub kyi sems gnyis po de rgyud la ma skyes pa skye bar byed pa'i thabs la 'bad cing*/ bar du yang byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis rgyud la skyes pa de nyid la sbyangs pas/ tha ma mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu chos sku dang gzugs sku mngon sum du thob nges pa yin/ de la dang po byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis rgyud la ma skyes pa skye bar byed pa'i thabs mang yang*/ mdor bsdu nas nyams su len pa la/ thabs kyi rtsa ba gsum/ yan lag gi gtso bo dgu las med/ dang po rtsa ba gsum ni/ blo sbyong ba dang*/ tshogs bsags pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin btsal ba dang gsum du 'dus/ de dag gi yan lag gi gtso bo dgu ni/ dang po blo sbyong ba'i thabs mang yang*/ mi rtag pa bsgom pa dang*/ byams snying rje bsgom pa dang*/ bdag med gnyis bsgom pa dang gsum gtso bo yin te/ blo sbyong gi thabs su de gsum kho na gtso che zhing gzhan thams cad de'i khongs su 'dus/ tshogs bsags pa la bsags thabs mang yang*/ bla ma'i bsnyen bskur dang*/

dkon mchog gi mchod pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bskur dang gsum gtso bo yin te/ tshogs gsog gi thabs de gsum kho na che zhing 'dus/ ting nge 'dzin btsal ba la btsal thabs mang yang*/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrung ba dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ lus sems dben par bsten pa dang gsum gtso bo yin te/ zhi gnas lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin btsal ba'i thabs su de gsum kho na che zhing 'dus/ de ltar don dgu po de dril nas nyams su blangs pas byang chub kyi sems (486)rnam pa gnyis ngang ngam shugs kyis rgyud la skye ste/ don dam byang chub kyi sems skyes tsam na phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong pa skye med spros bral du lhan gyis rtogs pa 'byung*/ de tsam na rang gi nang du blo bde rnyed pa yin/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems skyes tsam na/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la byams snying rje lhag par skye ste/ bya rgyu sems can gyi don las med pa cig 'byung*/ de tsa na ci byas sems can gyi don du 'gyur ba cig 'ong ba yin/ de gnyis zung du 'brel te stong pa'i dus nyid na ma 'gags pa'i sems can la snying rje lhag par skye la/ snying rje'i dus nyid na bdag dang sems can gyi dngos po ma mthong ste/ snang ba sgyu ma lta bu'i ngo bo stong par rtogs te zung 'brel du skyes tsa na theg pa chen po'i lam phyin ci ma la log par tshud pa yin/ de nyid la sbyangs pas goms pa mthar phyin tsam na chos sku dang gzugs sku lhun grub thob pa yin te/ don dam byang chub kyi sems stong pa nyid las chos sku/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems snying rje las gzugs sku/ de gnyis dbyer med du sbyangs pa las chos sku dang gzugs sku dbyer med du thob gsungs/ gzhan yang 'di dag gi gsung sgros dang zhal gdams ni shin tu mang bar 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba ni/

zhes pa 'di ni mang du thos pa'i dge slong blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi tsha kho dpon po ngag dbang grags pa la gdams pa'o// zhes gsungs te rgyal bas gsungs pa'i mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la ma gzigs pa'am ma mkhyen pa gang yang med pas mang du thos shing thos don bsam pas rnam par nges pa dang bsgoms pas nyams bzhes mthar phyin pa ngo bo 'jam dpal gzhon nu dang gnyis su med kyang rnam pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa yongs su grags pa'i mtshan blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis slob ma'i thu bo ngo (487)mtshar ba'i rnam thar du ma mnga' zhing sku tshe phyi mar kun mkhyen legs pa don grub tu 'khrungs nas zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa rgyal rong tsha kho dpon po ngag dbang grags pa la thugs brtse bas gdams pa'i snying por gnang ba'o// rgyal gsung snying po bsdus pa'i legs bshad phul// 'jam dbyangs gnyis pa'i gzhung bzang baiḍūrya// 'grel bshad rgyal mtshan mngon mtho'i rtser bkod kyang*// blo rmongs 'jug bde'i dga' ston 'di bskrun to// srid pa'i dpal las nges 'byung blo gros brtan// lhag bsam byang sems gser gyi yol go ru// rnam dag lta ba'i bdud rtsi yongs bskyil bas// thar 'dod rgud pa sel ba'i nyer 'tshor shog /bka' gdams brgyud pa'i lta spyod dri ma med// bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i rgyud la legs 'byor te// chos ltar bcos pas nam yang mi bslu bar// jo bo yab sras dgongs pa skong byed shog / ces pa 'di nyid kyi bshad rgyun kun gzigs bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po dang*/ paṇa chen rin po che'i 'grel ṭīka steng nas bka' drin tu stsal ba thob cing gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod du rgyun bzhugs pa la nye bar mkho bas mtshams sbyar te dngul chu ba dharma bha dra'i 'grel bsdus sor bzhag
